description: Source code for the API layer of the Focalboard server, defining REST API endpoints, route registration, error handling, and request validation.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Struct representing the API layer, holding dependencies and configuration for route handling.

methods.name: NewAPI
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new API instance with dependencies.

methods.name: RegisterRoutes
methods.description: Registers API routes under the /api/v2 path and other system routes.

methods.name: panicHandler
methods.description: Middleware to recover from panics in HTTP handlers and log errors.

methods.name: requireCSRFToken
methods.description: Middleware to enforce CSRF token validation.

methods.name: checkCSRFToken
methods.description: Checks if the request contains a valid CSRF token.

methods.name: hasValidReadTokenForBoard
methods.description: Validates read token for a specific board.

methods.name: userIsGuest
methods.description: Determines if a user is a guest, considering single user token override.
